brief: A planter of four cells with a water pipe running through the bases to feed every cell.
costSource: token-equivalent at Muse Spark Open shared rates, info only: the Dedicated Endpoint bills GPU seconds while up (.spend/modal-dedicated.jsonl)

requirements.evidence: Four full hex bases in a straight line at q=0,0 / 1,0 / 2,0 / 3,0 (piece:0,0,0;full through piece:3,0,0;full) each fitted with a third-depth drained bin (hex-bin-third-drain) acting as planter tray, filled with soil and planted.

requirements.requirement: Water pipe running through the bases
requirements.evidence: Single run run:run-1 placed at level 0 start entryEdge 3 through [1,0][2,0][3,0] — a straight pipe run through the base layer across all four cells, set to irrigation mode.

Run traverses every base cell (0,0 → 3,0); because bins are third-depth (hex-bin-third-drain) the configurator permits a straight through-run to coexist with bins, leaving all four bins serviced by the common line. End caps close all exposed faces while the run provides the shared water feed.

finish.summary: Built a 4-cell linear planter (649×467 mm footprint) with a single irrigation pipe run straight through the base layer from 0,0 to 3,0. Each cell holds a third-depth drained bin filled with soil and planted (lettuce, basil, parsley, mint) to show planter use. Joints bolted and open faces capped; mesh clash clear.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: 1 run IRRIGATION: non-potable supply. Corners are flexible hose, glued into Sch 40 sockets, one coupling wherever hose meets rigid pipe.

Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
